review_locator: PMCID:PMC5225158, The transcription factor network in Th9 cells
primary_title: Interferon-regulatory factor 4 is essential for the developmental program of T helper 9 cells
decision_basis: The review identifies IRF4 as a direct regulator of the Il9 locus; the cited primary shows IRF4-deficient or IRF4-silenced CD4 T cells lose IL-9 production, IRF4 binds the Il9 promoter by ChIP and IRF4-dependent reporter activity supports direct gene regulation.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the direct IRF4-to-IL9 gene bridge in Th9 differentiation. IRF4 is not sufficient outside the cooperative Th9 context; preserve BATF/PU.1/STAT6 and TGF-beta/IL-4 boundaries, and do not infer IL-9 secretion, receptor signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5225158, The transcription factor network in Th9 cells
primary_title: Th9 cell development requires a BATF-regulated transcriptional network
decision_basis: The review identifies cooperative BATF–IRF4 binding at the Il9 locus; the cited primary demonstrates reciprocal dependence of BATF and IRF4 promoter occupancy, composite-site reporter activation and reduced IL-9 expression when either factor is deficient.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the cooperative BATF/IRF4 gene-regulation bridge. Preserve the composite promoter site and reciprocal cofactor dependence; do not attribute the edge to BATF or IRF4 alone, infer IL-9 protein secretion or downstream receptor activation, or transfer allergic-inflammation/SCI effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3070307, Genomic views of STAT function in CD4+ T helper cell differentiation
primary_title: Temporal induction pattern of STAT4 target genes defines potential for Th1 lineage-specific programming
decision_basis: The review identifies TNF among STAT4-bound Th1 cytokine loci; the cited primary maps STAT4 binding at the Tnf locus in IL-12-stimulated CD4 T cells and links STAT4-dependent Th1 gene programming to TNF expression and secretion readouts.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the bounded STAT4-associated TNF gene-regulation bridge in activated Th1 cells. The primary includes intragenic STAT4 binding and does not establish a unique promoter mechanism; do not infer TNF protein release in every context, TNFR signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3070307, Genomic views of STAT function in CD4+ T helper cell differentiation
primary_title: Temporal induction pattern of STAT4 target genes defines potential for Th1 lineage-specific programming
decision_basis: The review identifies LTA among STAT4-associated Th1 cytokine loci; the cited primary places STAT4 binding at the Lta promoter in IL-12-stimulated CD4 T cells within the Th1 cytokine program.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the bounded STAT4-associated LTA gene-regulation bridge in activated Th1 cells. Preserve the promoter/Th1 context and avoid asserting direct protein secretion, receptor signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.
